description: On the table in front of you are a watercolor painting on paper, a white cup with water and a brush sticking out, a folded tissue, and a watercolor palette to the right. The left hand holds a clear brush or water brush as a left-hand object and rubs its tip against the tissue and over the paper area, while the right hand briefly pinches and steadies the brush as a two-hand object before letting go; then the left hand moves left and sets the brush down on the table near the tissue.
